'''Jez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] who was among those sent to dig up artifacts near the [[Dark Temple]]. After the temple was breached, [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spirits overwhelmed most of the people in the area, and Jez theorized that the possessed were drawn to the artifacts&mdash;they attacked the archaeologists when they attempted to pack up and leave.<ref name="TOR" />
